'''Riley''' was a [[Chiggnash]] criminal with a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-spotted yellow carapace who operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Wolf" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Riley acted on a tip from [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] attendant [[Shnozitskigante-maximilliana]] in an attempt to rob the incognito [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Nar Shaddaa. Supported by fellow Chiggnash [[Banda (Chiggnash)|Banda]] and a trio each of [[Control Mind (Chiggnash)|mind-controlled]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|sows]], [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] ''[[go-zeki]]'', and [[Cyborrean rabies|rabid]] [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dogs]], a [[Squib/Legends|squib]] [[tensor rifle]]-armed Riley cornered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in one of the moon's back alleys. Refusing to give in, Kenobi drew his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and slew the frog-dogs, before the Chiggnash and their [[warrior drone]]s were set upon by a pair of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Banda and Riley were [[Cho mai/Legends|dismembered and disarmed]] by former [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Chiggnash as they begged for mercy.<ref name="Wolf" />

Peña]].<ref name="Wolf" /> Along with that of Banda, Riley's name forms an anagram of "[[Brian Daley]]," creator of the Chiggnash.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52381816|board=Literature|thread=Abel G.
